findingDetails.title: Published benchmark totals disagree with the current checks
findingDetails.case: A maintainer uses the README benchmark summaries to decide how many checks and cases a complete run should report
findingDetails.evidence: The runner declares ten entries and computes its total from GATES. The root README and gate README say nine gates. The root README says 35 and 59 format cases in separate sections, and the router README says 94 synonyms while the current output says 114.
findingDetails.userImpact: Maintainers cannot use the published totals as a reliable check that the expected corpus and gates ran.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Directly counted ten GATES entries; the declared total is len(GATES). README.md contains conflicting format totals and the router documentation conflicts with the current differential output.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reconcile the published counts with the current runners and corpus, or generate those totals from the same source that prints the gate results.

findingDetails.title: Product Owner README contains a semicolon flagged by the voice gate
findingDetails.case: A reader follows the packet README as the user-facing guide to the Product Owner skill
findingDetails.evidence: The local format validator reports a prose-semicolon advisory at this line. Its source-file punctuation pass reports advice outside the strict instruction-file set.
findingDetails.userImpact: The guide contradicts the documented punctuation standard and leaves a known warning in routine source validation.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The validator run identifies this exact line; the Flow Mode reference and templates produced no punctuation warning.
findingDetails.recommendation: Split the sentence at the semicolon and keep the packet guide aligned with the voice standard.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Published gate, fixture and synonym totals may not match the current runners and corpus.

searchActions.queryOrPath: README benchmark totals and current gate/corpus declarations
searchActions.result: README totals conflict: 9 versus 10 gates, 35 versus 59 format cases, and 94 versus 114 synonyms. The runner declares ten gate commands and differential output derives synonym totals from the contract.

searchLedger.rationale: Published counts are inconsistent with the current gate array and with other reported totals in the same documentation set.

searchLedger.invariant: Product Owner prose avoids semicolons and em dashes under the stated voice standard.

searchActions.result: Validation passed with advisories, including a prose-semicolon advisory at sk-product-owner/README.md:231. Flow Mode files emitted no punctuation warning.

searchLedger.rationale: The gate identifies an HVR-banned punctuation instance in the packet guide, currently as a non-blocking source advisory.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Self-tests may return green without proving a clean baseline and rejection of their planted defect.

searchActions.queryOrPath: self_test functions and scratch-world unit test setup
searchActions.result: Flow and hub self-tests establish a clean pass, plant isolated defects and assert expected non-zero status; the plugin test repeats a build and tests divergence, symlink and bin refusal. Vendor tests build scratch repositories and assert outcomes. Tests were inspected statically, not executed.

searchLedger.rationale: Source assertions and isolated fixtures do not show a vacuous pass path; runtime execution was outside this static pass.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Each reviewed harness contains a clean baseline or scratch-world setup and explicit expected results.

searchLedger.invariant: The reference fence, executable Python contract, Project kernel copy and route corpus must be connected by a guard that exposes drift.

searchActions.queryOrPath: copy parity, table parity, behavior parity and corpus coverage guards
searchActions.result: The differential extracts the reference fence, checks the kernel copy, compares tables to the Python contract, compares behavior per input, and enforces corpus coverage for commands, false prefixes, topics and shapes.

searchLedger.rationale: The examined duplicated routing surfaces are joined by explicit copy, table, behavior and corpus guards.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Static guard paths cover the identified copies and inputs.
